summary: Twelve Tuesday evenings of practical skills for parents in Apex, July 28 through October 14. $30 per session, come to one or all twelve.

callout.title: A weekly workshop for parents
callout.body: Practical sessions on anxiety, boundaries, communication, and more. $30 each, come to what fits your week.

hero.sub: Twelve Tuesday evenings, 5 to 6:30 PM, taught by the clinicians who work with teens every day.

intro: This workshop teaches the same language and skills our clinical team uses with teens. There's no enrollment and no prerequisite: come to one session or all twelve.

It's for parents and caregivers only; teens aren't part of the room. Sessions combine psychoeducation with DBT-informed skills practice, and you're welcome whether or not your teen is a current patient here.

details.title: When
details.body: Tuesdays, 5:00 to 6:30 PM, July 28 through October 14, 2026.

details.title: Where
details.body: Joshua Tree Health, 800 West Williams St, Suite 203, Apex, NC 27502.

details.title: Cost
details.body: $30 per session. No package, no minimum number of sessions.

details.title: Who it's for
details.body: Parents and caregivers of teens and preteens, whether or not your teen is a current patient here.

closing.title: Not sure it's the right fit?
closing.body: Call and ask. We'd rather talk it through than have you guess.
